title: Shell execution from VBA or VB in vbnet — review required
description: Shell or ShellExecute runs an external program with a command line assembled in code. Office documents and VB applications that do this turn a document open or a form field into command execution with the user identity. The rule flags the call; whether the command line carries external text is a review decision.
remediation: Remove shell execution from document code, and in VB applications use ProcessStartInfo with an argument list and a fixed executable.
limitation: Lexical: matches Shell and ShellExecute calls; WMI-based execution is out of scope.
